summary: Keep roster rebuild telemetry attached to the admission-owning worker so concurrent diagnostic roots retain their complete counts and do not borrow another worker's admission identity.

replay.detail: Telemetry attribution and receiver-test synchronization only; no claims replay is added.

schema.detail: No database schema or persisted claim format changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or fleet coordination changes.

compatibility.detail: No client, protocol or harness compatibility requirements change.

downtime.detail: No additional interruption requirements beyond the normal binary upgrade.

manual.detail: No new manual steps; telemetry export remains opt-in.

recovery.detail: No persisted-state changes or additional rollback or roll-forward requirements.
